name: SportsDataIO
tagline: US major-league sports stats and fantasy data via REST APIs
description: SportsDataIO provides real-time and historical sports statistics, scores, projections, and fantasy data for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and other leagues. Developers integrate via REST endpoints with API-key authentication; trial and paid tiers support apps needing league coverage beyond open scrapes.

auth.details: API key via query parameter or header (verify in docs); self-serve developer signup

use_cases: get NFL scores for a given week
